traditions.d: The 'Klingenstadt' tradition of forged swords, knives, scissors and razors behind Wüsthof, Zwilling, Böker, Güde and Herder.
traditions.tech: drop-forging from a single blank with integral bolster, ice-hardening, hand finishing
traditions.mat: X50CrMoV15 stainless, carbon steels, POM and wood handles
traditions.auth: 'Solingen' is a protected origin mark; forged full tang, maker's trident/twins stamps

traditions.d: French knife capital where about a hundred companies make seventy percent of French kitchen, table and pocket knives, including the Sabatier houses.
traditions.tech: full forging, water-powered grinding historically, hand assembly
traditions.mat: carbon and stainless steel, boxwood, olive, ebony, POM
traditions.auth: 'Sabatier' alone is unprotected; look for registered house marks (K, Elephant, Lion, Diamant) and 'forgé à Thiers'

traditions.d: Sheffield has been famous for cutlery since the 17th century; crucible and stainless steel pioneered there, with remaining 'little mester' workshops.
traditions.tech: forging and grinding, crucible steel, stainless steel
traditions.mat: carbon and stainless steel, bone, horn and wood scales
traditions.auth: 'Made in Sheffield' mark and Cutlers' Company registered marks; vintage carvers often bear maker and 'Sheffield England'

notes: Shelf 'Western kitchen knives' rebuilt: 7 old kinds carried over (Chef's, Paring, Bread, Utility, Boning, Slicing→Carving knife, Cleaver) plus new tier kind Knife set. Range-only entries replaced by archetypes with versions for Chef's knife (Sabatier, Wüsthof Classic, Zwilling Four Star/Pro, Victorinox Fibrox, Global G-2, MAC Professional, Misono UX10, Opinel Parallèle) and Cleaver (CCK KF1303, Shibazi F208); old cleaver models kept in m. Miyabi ranges dropped from Chef's/Paring/Bread (Japanese-made Zwilling sub-brand belongs to Japanese knives shelf) but kept on Carving knife as sujihiki range. Sheffield tradition sourced from the Wikipedia Cutlery article (no dedicated Sheffield-cutlery page retrieved); centres listed there (Richardson Sheffield, Taylor's Eye Witness) are from my knowledge, to verify. Several brand founding years marked 'to verify' where the retrieved page did not state them; Zwilling Professional S, Global SAI/UKON and K Sabatier line names come from retrieved pages. No Wikidata entity found for Mercer Culinary; maker page used. Carved out: honing rods, whetstones, boards, shears go to the 'Boards, sharpening & storage' shelf; honesuki/gyuto to Japanese knives.
